alibabacloud-oss-backup-integration-diagnosis v0.0.2

- Expanded skill description and documentation for stricter execution and API usage boundaries.
- Made it clear that diagnosis is performed solely via the entry script, never by manual reasoning or additional scripts.
- Added explicit instructions to declare any missing input or unknown fact directly in the output, rather than prompting users for complete information up front.
- Clarified prohibition against all cloud API calls, cloud CLI commands, or any actions beyond configuration advice.
- Outlined new rules for reporting, especially for unknowns, degraded script status, and strict scope boundaries.
- Improved guidance on when and how to point users to sibling skills or human support.
